name: Vana Belle
positioning: Vana Belle, a Luxury Collection Resort, Koh Samui: an all-pool-suite and villa resort in a secluded cove on Chaweng Noi Beach
best_for: Couples who want a suite or villa with its own private pool
Travelers who want a quieter beach within reach of the island's attractions

facts.text: The resort is tucked into a secluded cove on the white sands of Chaweng Noi Beach.
The resort is set along 180 meters of Chaweng Noi Beach.
In Thai, 'vana' means forest and 'belle' means beautiful.
The suites and villas are designed in a contemporary style with indigenous Thai accents.
Villas and suites include features such as freestanding tubs.
Vana Spa uses a combination of traditional Thai and European techniques.
Vana Spa's signature treatment is the Siam Boran massage.
Lad Koh View Point is a shaded beachfront pavilion at the resort.
The concierge is a certified destination expert wearing the Les Clefs d'Or insignia.
The signature bubbly breakfast comes with free-flow Prosecco.
The resort has an air-conditioned library.
Chaweng Noi is a quieter district known for its peaceful beach.

highlights.text: All suites and villas have a private pool and a spacious terrace with views of the beach or the rainforest.
The freshwater beachfront infinity pool is steps from the waters of the Gulf of Thailand.
Resort experiences include Thai culinary tastings, cocktail and coconut coffee masterclasses, sunrise yoga and Muay Thai sessions.
Guests of the Grand Suites, Tropical Villas and Vana Belle Suites have a Personal Butler.
Secret Pond is a pool at the base of a man-made waterfall among the natural beachside rock formations.

considerations.text: Some resort experiences, refreshed weekly, may carry a supplementary charge.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires additional travel planning.
